fields.description_1: Schipholparkeren is built around one urgent visitor task: reserving secure parking close to Schiphol. The website needed to make arrival and return dates, parking choices and practical extras easy to understand before travellers commit to a reservation.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress journey around the booking flow, with clear choices for valet and comfort parking and supporting services such as charging, washing and refuelling. Safety, transparent pricing and FAQs support the decision while repeated reservation actions keep the next step obvious on desktop and mobile.

fields.description_1: Casareno focuses on construction, renovation and maintenance, from turn-key projects and new-build work to bathrooms, floors, stairs, doors, frames and finishing. The website needed to communicate that range while giving prospective clients enough project evidence and process detail to trust the company before requesting advice.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around services, completed projects and Casareno’s five-step working process. Visitors can move from a specific renovation or building need into relevant project examples, understand the route from introduction to delivery and then book a free advice conversation without losing context.

fields.description_1: Pastrycompany combines an online food shop with catering and event services. The website therefore needed to support quick product ordering while also giving customers enough information to consider larger catering or event requests.
fields.description_2: I organised the WooCommerce experience so product categories, offers and ordering stay easy to use, while catering, event services, reviews, location information and contact form a separate but connected route. This lets visitors switch naturally between buying products and planning a larger occasion.

fields.description_1: OurWP provides virtual-office and business-address services for entrepreneurs, including a KvK registration address, post handling and scanning options. The website needed to explain these practical services and packages clearly because visitors are often comparing addresses, pricing and registration requirements before signing up.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress journey around the main business-address proposition, package comparison and common practical questions. Clear signup, contact and account routes help visitors move from understanding the service to registering, while post-handling information remains easy to find throughout the site.

fields.description_1: ByDerma combines beauty treatments with a large WooCommerce product catalogue, appointments and member benefits. The main challenge was to keep treatment discovery, shopping and booking distinct enough to understand while still feeling like one consistent beauty platform.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress and WooCommerce experience around those separate tasks. Treatment information leads naturally to appointment booking, the webshop keeps product discovery and purchasing focused, and supporting account or membership content remains accessible without interrupting either journey. The same hierarchy stays clear on mobile.

fields.description_1: MDV Installaties brings electrical work, renovations, service and maintenance and locksmith support together in one business website. The structure needed to distinguish planned installation projects from service requests so visitors could identify the right help quickly.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content into clear service routes with practical explanations and direct contact points. Electrical work, renovation, maintenance and locksmith services each get enough context to stand on their own, while the responsive layout keeps urgent and planned enquiries easy to reach on smaller screens.

fields.description_1: C&K Bouw serves more than one audience: clients looking for construction support, employers needing professionals and people looking for work. The website needed to keep project capability and recruitment information separate so each visitor could reach the right content without sorting through the other journey.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress site around audience-specific routes for construction services, vacancies and staffing. Shared brand and trust content connects the experience, while clear enquiry and application actions help clients, candidates and employers move forward from the relevant section.

fields.description_1: Proline Afbouw offers specialist finishing services including latex spraying, system ceilings and walls, metal-stud work, plastering and painting. The website needed to separate these services clearly and give prospective customers enough project and review context before they request a quotation.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around dedicated service areas, supporting project examples and reviews. Clear quotation and contact routes stay close to the relevant finishing information, making the broad offer easier to scan and compare on desktop and mobile.

fields.description_1: Connectwerk serves both candidates looking for vacancies and employers looking for staffing support. The website needed to separate those two journeys while still using shared sector expertise to explain what Connectwerk does and where it adds value.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience so vacancy browsing and candidate registration form one clear route, while employer information and staffing enquiries form another. Sector-focused content supports both audiences without mixing their primary actions, keeping applications and business enquiries easier to complete.
